message.content: LiHua expresses very positive opinions about the graphics and gameplay of Black Myth: Wukong. Specifically, she mentions that the visuals are "stunning" and the world design is immersive. Regarding the gameplay, LiHua notes that the gameplay mechanics feel "fresh and exciting." Furthermore, she highlights the enjoyment she gets from the exploration aspect, noting that it's fun to discover new areas and secrets within the game. Her comments indicate that both the visual appeal and the engaging gameplay are key factors contributing to her enjoyment of the game.
